contract: Compare QuickTime PCM packet grouping and cross-track delivery order with the MOV demuxer with +noparse+nofillin, reading each packet through the compatibility payload reader.
Each packet folds stream index, PTS and DTS with their presence bits and raw values, duration, physical position, flags, size and every payload byte in delivery order.
Fold a terminal record for EOF or refusal.
Input loading and schedule parsing precede the operation. Both sides open, consume and release their readers inside it.

open_deviations.reading: A version 0 description outside the version 0 layout
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format 'Sound sample description version 0 (stsd)': version 0 is uncompressed raw or twos audio with one or two channels, 8 or 16 bits per sample and compression ID 0; this description lies outside it (more than two channels, or sowt byte order)
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the description (Unsupported: QT v0 PCM channel count other than 1 or 2; Unsupported: QT v0 PCM other than 8-bit raw or 8- or 16-bit twos)
open_deviations.reference: reads it as PCM: 3 to 8 channels, 16- to 32-bit sowt and 24- and 32-bit twos

open_deviations.reading: Zero channels in a version 0 description
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 0 (stsd)’ and ‘Sound sample data’: the supported channel counts are 1 and 2
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the description (Unsupported: QT v0 PCM channel count other than 1 or 2)
open_deviations.reference: reports a zero channel count and reads 16 payload bytes

open_deviations.reading: Compressed-audio fields carried in a version 0 PCM entry
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 0 (stsd)’ and ‘Sound sample data’ requires compression ID zero; Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 1 (stsd)’ uses -2 for redefined sample tables
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the description (Unsupported: QT v0 compressed/nonzero packet layout)

open_deviations.reading: A sample that ends inside a PCM frame
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 0 (stsd)’ and ‘Sound sample data’ defines the sample width and interleaved layout; Apple QuickTime File Format ‘Sound sample description version 1 (stsd)’ defines one frame as one sample from each channel; ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 §8.7.3.2.2 fixes each sample extent
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the track (Unsupported: PCM source samples are not consecutive one-tick sync frames)
open_deviations.reference: reads the configured two-byte width over the one-byte sample and emits 32 bytes, one past the declared extent

open_deviations.reading: Version 0 revision and vendor fields that must be zero
open_deviations.clause: Apple QuickTime File Format 'Sound sample description version 0 (stsd)': revision level and vendor must be set to 0; this entry has revision 37 and vendor test
open_deviations.candidate: refuses the description (Unsupported: PCM description revision, vendor or data reference other than 0, 0 and 1)
open_deviations.reference: reads 32 bytes as PCM at an integer 48000 Hz from the 48000.5 Hz rate field

open_deviations.reading: A chunk stored in the Movie Box
open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 6.1.3: the media data of a file is contained within its Media Data Boxes; stco places the second chunk of eight one-byte samples at offset 44, where the Movie Box starts (the mdat payload is 28..44)
open_deviations.candidate: reads the eight samples of the first chunk and refuses the second packet (Unsupported: PCM packet read outside the media extent)
open_deviations.reference: reads the first eight bytes of the Movie Box as the second packet, at position 44
